title: Paprika-Crusted Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 lb chicken wings, cleaned and trimmed
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (218°C).
Toss the chicken wings with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Place the wings in a baking dish or on a roasting pan. Drizzle with additional olive oil and paprika.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, turning halfway through, until golden brown and cooked through.
Serve hot with your favorite side.
comment: Coherente y cocinable; la lista de ingredientes omite el pimenton y el aceite que luego se usan.

title: Lemon-Dill Salmon Skewers
steps: Preheat grill or skillet to medium-high heat.
Thread salmon fillets onto skewers, leaving a little space between each one for even cooking.
Combine lemon juice, zest, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Drizzle over the salmon.
In a separate pan, sauté garlic until fragrant.
Place skewered salmon on grill or skillet, brush with garlic-infused oil, cover, and cook until salmon is cooked through (14-16 minutes for medium-rare).
Garnish with additional dill just before serving.
comment: Introduce ajo no listado y mezcla "cocido del todo" con "al punto"; brochetas de filete poco realistas.

title: Herbed Tomato Basil Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta according to package directions.
In a large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add cherry tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Cook until slightly softened, about 5 minutes.
Drain the pasta and combine with the tomato mixture. Toss to coat evenly.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh basil leaves.
comment: Plato clasico bien explicado; el ajo no aparece en la lista pero es un basico de despensa.

title: Simple Rice and Carrot Stir-Fry
steps: Heat a skillet over medium heat with olive oil. Add the chopped garlic and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, breaking it up as you go with a wooden spoon.
In another pan, whisk together soy sauce, water, and salt. Break in the eggs and allow them to cook until set but slightly runny on top.
Fold the scrambled eggs into the rice mixture.
Add the grated carrots to the skillet with the rice and stir-fry for 2 minutes or until the rice is heated through and the vegetables are tender-crisp.
comment: Usa arroz ya cocido sin indicar la coccion; anade soja y ajo no listados; orden de pasos algo confuso.

title: Beef Pot Roast with Rosemary and Garlic
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Place the beef in a roasting pan.
Cover with thyme, bay leaves, and salt.
Add the potatoes on top of the beef.
Drizzle with olive oil, cover tightly with foil, and roast for about 2 hours or until tender.
Remove from oven, add rosemary sprigs and garlic cloves, then return to oven for an additional 15-20 minutes to caramelize.
comment: Incoherencia: el paso 3 usa tomillo y laurel no listados; el romero y ajo del titulo se anaden al final.

title: Broccoli Garlic Stir-Fry
steps: Chop the broccoli into florets.
Finely mince the garlic.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add olive oil and swirl to coat the pan evenly.
Add the chopped broccoli to the skillet, stir-fry for about 5 minutes or until it begins to turn bright green.
Return the minced garlic to the skillet with the broccoli, stir-fry for an additional minute, allowing the flavors to meld together.
comment: Sencilla y correcta; pequeno error logico: dice "devolver el ajo" cuando nunca se retiro.
